etymologies.etymologyHTML: From Middle English favourable, from Old French favorable, from Latin favōrābilis, from favor. By surface analysis, favor +‎ -able.

quote.citation: 1871, Ohio State Medical Society, Transactions of the Annual Meeting, page 135:
quote.text: The conditions favorable to health and life of the indigines of the poles or the north temperate zones are destructive to the indigines of the tropical, and vice versa.
